title: Barn Wide Delts
author: Goncalo A.
desc: 3D looking delts for people that have trouble growing side and rear delts.

ss.note:
Light weight that allows 20 to 30 reps. 2 to 3 Rest pause are acceptable. When able to the 30 without pauses, up the weight.

Drop the shoulders to the floor to make sure the traps are not being used.
